task.description: Design and write the test specification and test code coverage for IDN-02 (Group management). Produce the test spec at tests/specs/IDN-02.md and create or update the backend test files needed to verify group creation, duplicate-name rejection, idempotent membership insertion, missing user or group handling, paginated membership listing, and GROUP-assignee task claim authorization for ACTIVE members. Ensure the spec exists before the test code, and make the tests deterministic and aligned with the backend design artifact.
acceptance_criteria: Every IDN-02 MUST acceptance criterion has at least one test case
A tests/specs/IDN-02.md file exists before any corresponding test code
Test cases cover group CRUD, membership idempotency, missing user handling, and group claim authorization
Tests are deterministic and do not rely on wall-clock timing or random values
The resulting test code references the implemented backend behavior from the design

result.summary: Produced and refreshed IDN-02 test specification first, then integration tests covering group creation, duplicate-name rejection, idempotent membership insertion, missing user/group handling, paginated membership listing, and GROUP-assignee claim authorization for ACTIVE members.
